issue.title: Named-Pomodoro capture targeting (`@route:id#pomodoro`)
issue.description: A capture can name exactly which Pomodoro in today's daily note receives its task link, using a typeable slug that supports multi-word names, with excellent Bob Mac Capture completion that also offers unnamed Pomodoros and names them in place.

issue.title: Pomodoro ledger scanner and `bob capture-pomodoros`
issue.description: pomodoro_ledger: add the shared named-Pomodoro scanner (name, slug, time range, current, stale-safe ref, selection) and the read-only discovery command that exposes it.

issue.title: `@route:id#pomodoro` grammar and capture execution
issue.description: capture_named_marker: extend the capture grammar with the third Pomodoro-name component, route it through capture execution's Pomodoro selection, and report it in capture-parse spans, needs, and diagnostics.

issue.title: `bob capture-pomodoro-name` write command
issue.description: pomodoro_name_command: add the single-purpose command that canonicalizes a name and appends it to one open, unnamed Pomodoro through an atomic rename.

issue.title: `capture-complete` Pomodoro-name context
issue.description: complete_pomodoro_name: return ranked pomodoro_name candidates, collapse duplicate slugs, and always offer never-filtered nameable rows for unnamed Pomodoros.

issue.title: Bob Mac Capture Pomodoro-name completion and naming prompt
issue.description: mac_pomodoro_name_ui: decode the additive candidate fields, render the Pomodoro completion rows, and add the inline naming prompt that writes the name before splicing the slug.

payload.entry: Implemented shared selector slug, Pomodoro ledger scanner, capture-pomodoros CLI, docs, smoke entry, and tests. Verified cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features, cargo test, manual BOB_DAY_FILE capture-pomodoros JSON and -a jq smoke; epic-symbols reported no leftovers.

Verified bob capture-pomodoro-name canonicalizes names, atomically appends or replaces the em-dash tail, preserves unrelated bytes including LF/CRLF, returns versioned JSON plus human output, and refuses stale/ambiguous/completed/already-named/missing-note writes with {ok:false} and no mutation. cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features, and cargo test passed. On a scratch daily note, exactly one placeholder line changed and capture-pomodoros -f json reported DEEP WORK / deep-work.

Verified cargo test (unit + CLI), cargo fmt, and clippy on the capture path. @dev:id#bugs dry-run JSON appends under BUGS while @dev:id inserts under the current Pomodoro; both notes stay unchanged. bob capture-parse -f json -- '@dev:some-id#' reports mode incomplete with needs ["pomodoro_name"]. Empty #, missing block ID before the name, invalid name chars, completed-only, unknown-name suggestion, unnamed-open, and multiple-open-timed-with-explicit-name cases match the design.

Implemented scanner-backed pomodoro_name completion with duplicate-slug collapse and never-filtered nameable rows; verified cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features, cargo test, and sase bead epic-symbols bob-cli-1t.4.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Linux CaptureCoreTests process-timeout flakes — testCancellationTerminatesProcess and testRunTerminatesAndThrowsTimedOutWhenProcessOutlivesTheTimeout failed to observe Process.terminate() on this Linux host; they look pre-existing and unrelated to Pomodoro-name work.

Implemented Bob Mac Capture pomodoro_name completion and the Name Pomodoro prompt in the linked bob-mac-capture repo, modeled on Add block ID.

Verified on Linux: swift build --target CaptureCore; swift test --filter Pomodoro and the new capture-complete fixture test all passed (candidate decoding including absent additive fields, CapturePomodoroNameResponse success/failure, row content for selectable/nameable/current/duplicate-slug rows, assignPomodoroName argv). Package.swift now omits the AppKit app target on Linux so CaptureCoreTests can run. No --epic-symbol leftovers.

Not run here (Linux, no AppKit): just format-lint, just build, just test, BobMacCaptureTests (prompt splice/prefill/mutual-exclusion/failure cases are written). App-target result needs the macOS 26 SwiftPM GitHub Actions workflow after this lands.

Verified all five phases against the plan, the source, and the shipped commits (cc4c9a3, 9b7282d, a03bd58, 50a69c3 in bob-cli; c9f2e9f in bob-mac-capture); every child note's claims hold up.

Code review: selector grammar has one owner (capture_language::selector_slug / is_selector_component), and the capture_pomodoros scanner matches task-status-cycler's parsePomodoroEntryLineParts rule for rule (leading placeholder-or-time-range, ^[ \t]*—[ \t]*(.*)$ name tail, slug, selectable, child_count, single-open-timed is_current), so Bob and Obsidian cannot disagree about what a named Pomodoro is. select_named is open-only with whole-slug-beats-first-prefix precedence; the timed.len() > 1 guard now applies only to the two implicit variants; capture-pomodoro-name writes through collect_done::atomic_write (same-directory temp + rename) and re-scans before reporting success; capture-complete collapses duplicate slugs and appends never-filtered nameable rows.

just all is green: cargo fmt --check, clippy (6 warnings, all pre-existing in dataview/plugins/projects/task_status_hooks/vault_sync), and 1187 tests across all suites. bob-mac-capture's macOS 26 SwiftPM CI run 33196599944 passed every job for c9f2e9f, which closes the gap bob-cli-1t.5 flagged as unverifiable on Linux (lint, build, test including BobMacCaptureTests, bundle, signature, launch smoke).

Manual end-to-end on a fixture vault: capture-pomodoros JSON/human and -a; '@dev:x#memory' reaching MEMORY over an earlier MEMORY WORK prefix match while skipping the current timed Pomodoro, and '#memory-w' reaching MEMORY WORK; unknown-name slug list, completed-only, and empty-'#' errors verbatim as designed; capture-pomodoro-name canonicalizing '  deep   work ' to DEEP WORK/deep-work with exactly one changed line, then refusing already-named, completed, and stale refs write-free; capture-complete after '#' returning named-then-nameable rows with refs, badges and match_count. Compatibility invariants re-checked live: '@@dev:x#bugs' still errors as an unsupported global destination, capture-rewrite leaves a PomodoroTask marker unabsorbed, a trailing bare '#' is still a pomodoro_note, '@dev#sec:x' is still a bullet and '@dev+id#sec' still a sub-bullet, and '@dev:id#' is incomplete with needs ["pomodoro_name"]. CLI rules hold: alphabetized subcommands and options, a short alias on every long option, colored-when-tty output. Docs and README rows, the install-smoke list, and the capture --help example are all in place.

Integration: nothing landed anywhere between the epic's first commit and this landing. bob-cli master contains only the epic's four commits after cc4c9a3 and is level with origin; bob-mac-capture's previous commit predates the epic by three days; bob-plugins' 2026-08-28 commits (bab14b0, 59855bd, b57e485) all landed before the epic started and touch only bob-navigation-hotkeys, leaving the ported parity source untouched since 66d97cc. Checked the recently landed work that could conflict: '9b534e3 fix(capture): start scheduled captures blocked' composes correctly — '@dev:x-id#bugs body s:3' writes a [?] Blocked task with [scheduled::] and links it under BUGS; task_status_hooks::scan_pomodoros collects task references and shares only pomodoros_section_range with the new scanner, so it duplicates nothing; the Pomodoro glossary strand already documents the ' — NAME' suffix (78e219b) and needs no update.

Follow-ups: bob-cli-1t.5's PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP is real but not a flake — testCancellationTerminatesProcess and testRunTerminatesAndThrowsTimedOutWhenProcessOutlivesTheTimeout fail deterministically on Linux across two consecutive runs while macOS CI is green, and both predate the epic (9030832/88cc781); c9f2e9f's macOS-only Package.swift split merely made them observable. Filed as bob-cli-1u (ci, large, ready). Separately found that all five epic commits carry SASE_PLAN=[202608/highlights_annotation_tasks_section.md] instead of this epic's plan, because capture_named_pomodoro.md is machine-local and absent from the bob-cli--plans store; filed as bob-cli-1v (bug, large, ready) and linked to bob-cli-y. sase bead epic-symbols bob-cli-1t reports no entries; this project has no symvision recipe or binary.
